issues.description: The Bitmap24::save method is declared to return int in the template header but its implementation returns void. This mismatch will cause a compilation error and confuses students about the intended API. The solution repository's header uses void, which indicates the intended signature is void save(const std::string&).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the declaration and the definition use the same return type. Prefer updating the template header to match the implementation and the solution: change 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);'. Alternatively, change the implementation to return int and return a status code, and update the solution accordingly.
